entries.en: to divine, to cast lots or divine by hexagrams
to be startled, to be frightened; to marvel

entries.zh: 大为惊骇（吓生年）：吃惊非常
entries.notes: 「生年」为闽南语夸张补语（惊生年），展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 惊骇非常（吓吓年）：同上，惊讶至极
entries.en: to be extremely startled, utterly astonished
entries.notes: R 栏「tē」与 M 栏「hià̃」叠字对应，解释依赖推断。

entries.en: to be startled, to take fright

entries.zh: 惊惶：因事多繁杂而心慌意乱；惊惶失措
entries.en: to be alarmed and flustered, disquieted by many affairs
entries.notes: 西语「ocuparse con los muchos negocios」与汉字「愴惶」语义有出入，取折中。

entries.en: to be frightened, to be seized with fear
to admit, to accept, to receive

entries.zh: 收纳（礼金、赏赐或入伙）：收受
entries.en: to receive (gifts, rewards, or into company), to take in
entries.notes: 西语含 dadiuas/oruegos/oala compañia 等古拼，须展开推断。

entries.zh: 纳势：收受好处、徇情应人所请
entries.en: to take bribes or favors, to comply with entreaty
entries.notes: 「纳势」为生僻闽南语组合，语义依赖西语旁注（haçer loque le ruegan）推断。

entries.zh: 椒料、香料配剂：调味香料之配制
养：收养（同收养义），抚育为子
entries.en: to adopt, to bring up as one's child
numbness of the flesh, to be benumbed
entries.notes: M 栏「herpon.]」旁注未明，取官话「痲」主义。

entries.zh: 痲药：麻药，使人肉体麻痹之药
